about.title: One craftsperson, one workshop, one piece at a time

paragraphs.one: Our story began with a deep respect for craftsmanship and woodworking traditions passed down through generations. In 2012, we opened our workshop in Kyiv, where every piece is carefully made by hand, sanded and finished with natural oil.
paragraphs.two: We work with oak, walnut, ash, pine, cedar, cherry and maple sourced from responsibly managed Ukrainian forests. No mass production and no shortcuts — just wood, tools and time.
